initial.name: walk
initial.prompt: Reference image defines character costume and identity ONLY; do NOT repeat its single walking pose. Make a new TRUE TWO-STEP locomotion sprite sheet. SIX frames in exactly THREE columns by TWO rows on transparent background. Read top row 1 2 3 then bottom row 4 5 6. Full bodies with BOTH BOOTS completely visible, generous gutters. Same slender athletic white-haired man, short-sleeve black shirt under open sleeveless dark hooded vest, cyan/magenta piping, silver LEFT forearm armor. Side view facing RIGHT in ALL frames, fixed anatomical sides, do not horizontally flip the character or swap his prosthesis. CRITICAL ANATOMY: NEAR leg (character LEFT) wears the large BURGUNDY rectangular THIGH CARGO POCKET; FAR leg (character RIGHT) has a PLAIN dark thigh, no large red pocket. Keep these identities FIXED across frames. Frame 1 and frame 4 MUST use OPPOSITE LEGS in front: frame1 BURGUNDY POCKET LEG IN FRONT toward right; frame4 PLAIN THIGH LEG IN FRONT toward right, burgundy pocket leg clearly BEHIND toward left. This is the most important requirement. Do not repeat same-leading-foot cycle. No speed trails, no text, no labels, no scenery, no shadows. Crisp pixel-art clusters consistent with reference, no smooth painting. Logical cells128x192, can use integer enlargement. Same physical scale in all poses, common floor baseline, pelvis stays at same horizontal position. Keep limbs narrow, torso not bulky. WALK cycle with NO both-feet-airborne jump: frame1 NEAR pocket leg heel contact forward to right, FAR plain leg back to left. Frame2 NEAR pocket leg vertical support underneath pelvis, FAR plain knee passes forward across supporting leg. Frame3 NEAR pocket leg extends backward pushing off to left, FAR plain leg extends forward preparing heel contact to right. Frame4 FAR PLAIN leg heel contact forward to right, NEAR POCKET leg stretched backward to left; burgundy thigh pocket MUST now visibly be left/back side of hips. Frame5 FAR plain leg vertical support underneath pelvis, NEAR pocket knee passes forward. Frame6 FAR plain leg pushing backward left, NEAR pocket leg reaches forward right to return into frame1. Arms counter-swing, including both directions of silver-arm swing. Calm upright walk, minimal head bob. Bottom row must be the OPPOSITE half stride of top row, never duplicate top row.

cleanup.name: walk
cleanup.prompt: Edit this sprite sheet for game export. Preserve the character, style and SELECTED EXISTING poses, do not invent a new costume or proportions. Keep EXACTLY source frames 1,2,4,5 (top-left, top-middle, bottom-left, bottom-middle). These form near-leg-contact, near-leg-support, FAR-leg-contact, far-leg-support. VERY IMPORTANT retained third frame must have the BURGUNDY POCKET leg clearly BACK to the left and PLAIN thigh leg FRONT to right, as in source bottom-left. Retained fourth frame is source bottom-middle with metallic arm forward. Do NOT replace with duplicate near-leg-forward poses. Repack the FOUR retained poses into TWO columns by TWO rows, in the specified order. CRITICAL clean alpha: erase ALL haze, colored light, black background, gradients, floor shadows and glows between and around figures. Every pixel outside actual body/clothing must be fully TRANSPARENT, not translucent gray haze. No ambient illumination outside silhouette, no halo. Large clear padding all around EACH full figure, especially both boots: zero crop, neither boot touches edge or neighboring cell. Same anatomical scale, consistent head size and root position, no changing body thickness, no mirroring character. Pixel art, shirt beneath open vest, white hair, cyan accents, metallic left arm unchanged. The foreground should contain ONLY the four isolated bodies and nothing else. This is FOUR poses of a complete TWO-step cycle, including the opposite-leg phase, NOT repeated same-foot poses.
